verdict.rationale: Event subscription via webhooks is a fair axis for an AI assistant platform, since such products can expose event triggers to integrations, so the story applies. The evidence pack covers only in-app features: connectors for reading OneDrive, Outlook and Google data, browser actions, and Cowork tasks. None of it mentions webhooks, event subscriptions or callback endpoints, and probes found no OpenAPI spec, so the capability is unevidenced.
